x-bump-note: 2.1.0 adds optional members[].continued_by, written by a continuation-dispatch wake. 2.0.0 removed caps and counters (the send hook is advisory-only) and named the overseer as the roster writer. RE-VENDOR: claude-klabauter vendors this schema byte-exact (coordinator_core/frontmatter/schemas/chatty-roster.schema.json).
description: Roster of an opt-in chatty workflow run, written to <run-dir>/roster.json. Absence of the file means the run is not chatty and the guard is a no-op. Read-side rule not expressible in JSON Schema: members[].nonce values must be unique within the roster (a reader must reject duplicates). There are no caps or counters and no counters writer. The overseer agent writes this file as its first act after nonce self-ID; the emitter cannot, since there is no runId at emit time.

overseer_role.description: Role of the only member briefed to send to main (a convention, not enforced). Must name a member role (read-side rule).

nonce.description: Per-member token placed in the brief; uniqueness across members is a read-side rule.

agent_id.description: Null until the member registers by resolving its nonce.

continued_by.description: agentId of the fresh continuation agent that carried this member's role on after it returned; set by that continuation.
